# Faby — full description (English)

> Faby is a mobile app for iOS and Android that creates personalized, illustrated
> bedtime stories for children aged 2–12, with the child as the hero, and reads
> them aloud. Website: https://www.fabyfun.com/en/ · Contact: info@yelkovan.ai

## How it works

1. A parent creates an account (Google, Apple or email) and describes the hero:
   the child's name, age group, appearance and interests.
2. The parent picks a theme, a lesson (value) and a mood, and can add friends or
   a pet as side characters.
3. Faby writes an original story with an AI language model, generates matching
   illustrations and narrates the story with a selectable voice.
4. Stories are saved to the family library to read again.

## Main features

- Personalized AI stories with the child as the hero (6 pages; 8–10 pages with Pro).
- Illustrations in several drawing styles.
- Read-aloud narration with several voices.
- Interactive stories where the child makes choices (Pro).
- A library of classic fairy tales (Cinderella, Snow White, Puss in Boots, …).
- Drawing tools, quizzes and a story dictionary.
- Weekly parent report in the app; optional weekly report email for Pro parents.
- Nine app languages: English, Turkish, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian
  Portuguese, Arabic, Hindi, Chinese.

## Pricing

- Free to download. A guest can create one story for free.
- Faby Pro: monthly or yearly subscription through the App Store or Google Play.
  Includes 10 new stories a week, longer stories, extra voices and drawing styles,
  interactive stories, the full weekly report and the weekly report email.
  Where offered, the yearly plan starts with a free trial.
- Coins: one-time packs; a standard story costs 100 coins, an interactive story 150.

## Safety and privacy

- iOS: listed in the Apple Kids category (Made for Ages 6–8); no ads, no
  third-party analytics and no SKAdNetwork on iOS.
- A parental gate protects every purchase and every link that leaves the app,
  and is never remembered.
- No free-text chat between users; nicknames are chosen from word lists.
- AI providers receive only what is needed to write, illustrate and narrate a
  story. Full details: https://www.fabyfun.com/en/privacy.html
- Accounts and data can be deleted in the app or by email:
  https://www.fabyfun.com/en/delete-account.html
